title: E-Bike Rental - 2 Hour Rental in Historic Downtown Sanford
requirements: Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Take an adventure in Historic Downtown Sanford! Rent an e-bike pedal assist and cruise through historic downtown Sanford, check out the historic homes in the residential district, or ride the Sanford RiverWalk, a multi-use pedestrian trail that runs along Lake Monroe. 

E-bike pedal assist rental bikes are Specialized Turbo Como SL 4.0, and are designed as a sporty and comfortable electric cruiser with an easy-to-step-through frame that makes hopping on a breeze.

A helmet and a bike lock are available for use with rental. Reservations must be made in advance for rentals.
